data.body: [P2] Clear callback IDs once a checkpoint response has already delivered their terminal state. A callback can complete while its submitter is still running; a subsequent checkpoint can return that callback to the same invocation and advance `handler_seen_seq`, but this list entry survives until the next invocation. If the handler later suspends, the callback is reported as updated again, so `on_operation_end` fires twice across invocations and execution-view OTel can export a duplicate span. Prune delivered IDs when checkpoint responses advance the delivery watermark for all three callback outcomes, and add a callback-completes-during-submitter followed by wait/resume regression.
